checkedAlternates.risk: A torque wrench measures applied rotational torque.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A torque wrench’s primary action is driving/tightening fasteners (group-4), unlike a dedicated measuring instrument like a caliper (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: Pliers are sometimes used to turn stuck nuts.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Locking pliers are designed for gripping and clamping (group-2), not precision driving (group-4).
